title: A risk a worker names in its report is filed as a draft bug before the item lands
goal: a risk of its own fix that a worker names in its report (a stale checkout, a host state) is filed as a draft bug, or run through the review brief, before the orchestrator lands the item

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=t.split('## run',1)[1].split('## review',1)[0].lower()
miss=[w for w in ['risk named in a worker report'] if w not in s]
sys.exit('not yet: run section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
